output.reason: [ev-fd9871fe4e94] says #22130 is a straight revert of #21065, and it touches the same four files as #21065 [ev-615fbf55bc0a][ev-10e44c188321], including util/rbac/rbac.go. [ev-c717873ca6a1] says what #21065 added: a check that every user-defined RBAC role is referenced by at least one policy. The check ran in `argocd admin settings rbac validate`, and when a policy loaded it logged a warning for any role with no policy referencing it. So the subject is that RBAC role check, the change is that it is removed, and the consequence is benign: `rbac validate` no longer flags roles without policies and that warning is no longer logged. One gap lowers confidence: the evidence does not say whether #21065 ever shipped in an earlier release, so the revert may cancel a change that no release ever contained.
